question: Can the proposed source-minus-background entry12 writes identify whether the sufficient A1 coordinate, A2 coordinate, or off branch should execute?

prior_art.known_lessons: The gold mixture composes; native base state is information-theoretically unable to separate paired A1/P rows because their base texts are identical; held labels and behavioral outcomes may not gate the intervention.
prior_art.novelty: Route on the concatenated semantic-position A1-oracle and A2-oracle proposed entry12 deltas, which depend on source and background but precede the downstream intervention and output.

frozen_design.router_features: Concatenate the A1-oracle and A2-oracle on-minus-off entry12 vectors at the semantic position; subtract the opposite-parity training mean and L2-normalize.
frozen_design.router: Three deterministic cosine nearest centroids for A1, A2, and off=(P union C), fit on opposite parity only; ties resolve A1 then A2 then off. No hyperparameter selection.
frozen_design.causal_program: Use the predicted branch to select the matching expert delta or zero, project through the opposite-parity two-construction DIM union, and install it at entry12. The router observes no logits, answer IDs, held labels, or downstream outcomes.
frozen_design.controls: Report source-feature duplicate distances, confusion, learned/gold programs, ungated expert unions, full and zero replays, A1/A2 effects, and P/C KL/flips.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_scope_geometry_f: Hashes, authorities, exact base-text impossibility audit, replays, disjoint crossfit, finite geometry, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_source_router_identifies_held_bra: Held macro accuracy is >=.875 in both parities and no P/C row is predicted A1/A2.
predictions.pred_c_routed_union_preserves_both_targe: The routed program projects >=.75 with direction fraction >=.875 on A1 and A2 in both held parities.
predictions.pred_d_routed_union_is_control_selective: The routed program has zero P/C flips and changed-versus-off mean KL <=.02 in both parities.
predictions.pred_e_router_retains_ungated_union_effe: Each routed target projection is at least 90% of its corresponding ungated union projection.

decision: A failure invalidates. B/C/D/E licenses OOD router evaluation and weight translation of the router and two causal coordinates. Gold pass with B failure rejects nearest-centroid source routing. B without C rejects mixture composability. C without D shows source features still confuse answer-preserving transformations.
